title: Poolrooms Blocks
description: I've added poolrooms stuff to the game!   [Alpha]
body:
Adds blocks from the poolrooms (they are uncraftable. sad.)

List of blocks:

  Pool tiles
  
  Pool tile stairs (block.poolrooms_tiles:ruby_stairs)
  
  Pool tile slab (block.poolrooms_tiles:ruby_slab)
  
  Blue Pool tiles (block.poolrooms_tiles:blue_pool_tiles)

I only know english, so dont ask for other languages.
